svg.title: CI/CD Pipeline: Push to Deploy
svg.desc: A CI/CD pipeline showing four stages: trigger, test, build, and deploy, with each stage containing jobs and steps.
svg.text: developer pushes code → GitHub → pipeline triggers automatically
